worldcombat.skill.sheercold.summary: Drop the small patch of air around the target to absolute zero: frost spreads outward in a ring, everything inside is frozen in one blow, and a short-lived sheet of snow is left on the ground. It is the only member that can take several foes at once, and the only one whose user changes how fast it comes out - an Ice type freezes far sooner.
Locks a ring of %1$s blocks around the target; at the freeze, every non-Ice target inside is finished in one blow. The target's defence, armour and toughness do not apply - only Ice itself is immune.
There are %1$s s between locking the ring and the freeze; an Ice-type user shortens it sharply, and every level above the target shortens it further, so those inside must step out in that time.
The frosted ground stays %1$s s across about %2$s blocks before the original blocks return.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.glacial.on: Glacial form: freeze radius x1.2 and a longer-lived frost, at the cost of +7 ticks of freeze delay and +10 cooldown - a larger, longer-lasting ring with a slower warning.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.glacial.off: Flash form: freezes sooner and recharges faster, but a smaller ring and a shorter frost.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.growth.0: From level %1$s the freeze radius reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.growth.1: From level %1$s the freeze radius reaches %2$s blocks and the frosted ground lingers %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.use.0: Freeze several foes in one ring around the target
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.use.1: Let an Ice-type user steal a much shorter window
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.use.2: Leave a short-lived frost sheet that marks the frozen zone
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.preference.g: On: freeze radius x1.2 and frost x1.3 longer, at the cost of +7 ticks of freeze delay and +10 cooldown - a larger ring with a slower warning. Off (flash form): freezes sooner and recharges faster, but a smaller ring and a shorter frost.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.preference.a: The companion only considers sheer cold while the threat is within this distance; smaller keeps it close, larger closes into the radius from further away.
Casts only with at least this many visible, non-Ice enemies inside the freeze radius; larger saves it for being surrounded, 1 freezes a single foe.
Below this health ratio the companion stops spending an instant kill on the target; higher keeps it for healthy foes only.
